summary: Tested Field Team Dashboard enhancement (portfolio graphs + full retailer dashboard rendering). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass (existing 8 + 10 new proxy endpoint tests for /{rid}-dispatches, -rejections, -invoices, -indents, -payments, -grn, /dashboard-data, /immediately-payable including auth guards). Frontend (as adb@gmail.com/fieldteam123): Portfolio home renders 4 summary cards (Retailers=2, Immediately Payable=₹18,199, Overdue=₹15,596, Outstanding=₹20,802), Portfolio Earnings card (₹46,510 total, ₹427 avg/day over 109 days) with date-range picker, View toggle (Daily/Weekly/Monthly all clickable and update charts), and the 4 required charts render correctly with data (Monthly Order Value, Monthly Rejection MRP with 19.8% badge, Monthly Earnings, Avg. Earning/Day). Retailer cards for Tamanna Mart and S Mart expand to show Outstanding/Pending Indents/Today's Dispatches/Today's Value + 'View Full Dashboard' button. Clicking 'View Full Dashboard' renders the full Retailer Portal Dashboard (Tamanna Mart header with back arrow, Create New Order card + Create Order button, Avg Net Sales ₹3,896, Rejection % 15.9%, Your Earnings ₹53,155 with 4 charts + Daily/Weekly/Monthly toggle, 7 stat cards: Items Received=10226, REJECTION=-1794, Items Sold=8432, Total MRP Value=₹2,65,775, Payable by You=₹2,12,620, Paid Amount=₹1,92,073.78, Pending Amount=₹20,546.22). Back arrow returns to portfolio view. Hamburger side menu shows My Portfolio, MY RETAILERS section with Tamanna Mart & S Mart, and Logout — clicking a retailer navigates into that retailer's full dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: Field team Dashboard.js side-menu 'My Portfolio' handler resets viewMode to 'cumulative' even if user is already on portfolio (no-op is fine, but menuItems.map applies bg-[#14532D] active styling to ALL menu items unconditionally since it doesn't check active state).
Proxy endpoints /field-team/retailer/{retailer_id}-dispatches etc. return up to 1000-5000 records unbounded; consider pagination for large retailers.

The /field-team/retailer/{retailer_id}/dashboard-data endpoint currently returns hardcoded zeros in summary ({total_orders:0, pending_orders:0, total_spent:0}) — retailer object is real but summary is a stub. Frontend may not rely on it (uses per-collection proxies) but the stub could be misleading.
Two overlapping endpoints exist: /field-team/retailer/{rid}/dashboard (rich) and /field-team/retailer/{rid}/dashboard-data (stub). Consider consolidating to avoid confusion.
Retailer Dashboard.js is 8380 lines — should be split into smaller components for maintainability.
